2026-11-25.1.note: TD-718 repair (owner ruling 2026-11-25). (1) freshness.py: in the household-wide STR de-dupe an approved STR (current / unconfirmed), or a rejected one, is never superseded by an STR that is neither (not_approved, wrong_type, unreadable, stale, future, unknown); genuineness still leads; non-STR ranking unchanged. 2026-11-25.2.note: TD-718 repair round 2 (owner ruling 2026-11-25).
